answer: Any identity can be challenged by a peer staking 10,000 POA: within one epoch it must show a kernel receipt — a chained hash of one real job from its voyage across three domains — verified by three auditors. A fake whose fable of work cannot be verified loses its 70,000 POA bond: burned, half to the challenger, identity banned 12 epochs, slot revoked; a challenger who cries wolf loses its 10,000 stake. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 70,000 = 70,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 70,000 POA bond once. The limit: honest agents working quietly can be harassed by repeated challenges.
